ModMetaData.name: Project Mamono Elementals
ModMetaData.author: Gapho
ModMetaData.description:
Adds eight wild elementals to RimWorld 1.6, for Project Mamono.
The eight species are the gnome, ignis, sylph, undine, dorome, dryad, apsara and genie, of earth, fire, wind, water, clay, wood and joy. Each one arrives only on land that suits her: caves, deserts and lava fields, high mountains, rivers and coasts, wetlands, or forests.
Elementals arrive in the wild, walking onto your map like wild men. You tame one, or capture her and convince her to join. Each has a power of her own: the gnome heals on bare ground, the sylph's mood turns with the wind, the undine is quick in the rain, the dorome swims through the earth, the dryad lives on sunlight, the apsara charms everyone near her, and the ignis sets desire alight with her blows. The genie is not found wandering: a lamp is found in the desert, and the colonist who cleans it frees her and earns one wish a year.
Requires Harmony, Biotech, Odyssey, Project Mamono, and Big and Small - Framework.
